description: Free. Yesterday on pump.fun (one UTC day), or any day kept: coins launched and graduated, SOL and USD volume, traders, failed transactions; who made money (top 10 wallets by net SOL, the 5 biggest losers, the share of traders down); the top coins by volume, the fastest graduations, the biggest launches; launches and the 1 h graduation rate per UTC hour; launches dead by their second hour; the busiest deployers. `summary` is one paragraph to quote. Each wallet and coin names the paid call that goes deeper (wallet_records, launch_record).

day.description: a UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD; default the latest
